property_summary: For every input, the correct contract always successfully forwards calls to the callee using the transferFrom(address,address,uint256) selector (so transfer(...) never reverts when the callee's transferFrom succeeds); the mutant uses a different selector (transfer(address,address,uint256)) which can target a non-existing function on the callee and thus cause the call (and therefore transfer) to fail for some callee implementations.
change_summary: Change the selector to transfer(address,address,uint256) (different signature), causing calls to likely fail or hit different function and thus altering observed effects.
